messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nTeams are overwhelmed by excessive supplier invoices and policyholder letters, making it hard to track or report accurately. This disorganization slows down decisions and increases risk of errors.\n\n## Who is affected\n- The claims-handling team at Sallowmere Motor is affected, as they report being overwhelmed by disorganized documentation [i:e88028629f02b11a].\n\n## Evidence\n- 1 account has mentioned this problem [i:e88028629f02b11a].\n- There have been 1 total mention of this problem [i:e88028629f02b11a].\n- This problem has been mentioned through 1 route: sales [i:e88028629f02b11a].\n- The account states: Exactly — we ... we’re drowning ... and our reporting ... is all over the place. [i:e88028629f02b11a].\n- The ARR figure for Sallowmere Motor is null [i:e88028629f02b11a].\n- The total ARR across all accounts is 0 GBP [i:e88028629f02b11a].\n- There have been 0 renewals in the last 90 days [i:e88028629f02b11a].\n- The fact sheet data is current as of 2026-11-03 [i:e88028629f02b11a].\n\n## Why now\nThe problem was explicitly mentioned by Sallowmere Motor on 2026-10-18 [i:e88028629f02b11a].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "e88028629f02b11a",
   "quote": "Exactly — we ... we’re drowning ... and our reporting ... is all over the place.",
   "account": "Sallowmere Motor",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-18T10:32:00Z"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "sales": 1
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Sallowmere Motor",
    "arr_gbp": null,
    "renewal_date": null,
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem statement claims teams are overwhelmed by 'excessive supplier invoices and policyholder letters,' but the cited quote only says 'we're drowning ... and our reporting ... is all over the place' — the specific document types are not supported by the citation. The claims about slowed decisions and increased risk of errors are also uncited. The quantitative items (1 account, 1 mention, 1 route via sales, ARR null/0 GBP, 0 renewals, dates) all match the fact sheet and cited insight, but the overstated scope fails.", "verdict": "fail"}
